approved_scope: Remediate the two Major and one Minor child review v2 findings without changing the approved M4.1 abstractions or adding write behavior.

design_preflight.owning_module: knora.tools application seams plus knora.adapters.http and the SQLite support-provider adapter
design_preflight.interface: ReadTool.execute, AuthorizedExternalResource, LookupTicketRequest, SupportToolGateway.lookup_ticket and the Workspace-scoped ticket-lookup HTTP route
approved_seams: SQLite reference-provider contract independent from ToolActionStore
current_responsibilities: authorize an integrity-protected ticket reference against the current binding
construct one typed lookup request and invoke the provider gateway
normalize provider lookup outcomes into the closed M4.1 result set
authenticate and authorize the Workspace-scoped HTTP request
design_preflight.new_responsibility: Preserve exact binding identity/version/digest at the gateway seam, close malformed or unexpected provider outcomes, and restore the documented HTTP adapter dependency direction.
design_preflight.rationale: The binding fields deepen existing typed values, provider normalization remains cohesive in the gateway adapter, and the router relocation moves an existing transport responsibility to its already-approved owner without creating a new abstraction. No source file crosses a structural trigger.

confirmed_test_seams.authority: Issue #75, the externally approved M4 design, locked guide m4-75-ticket-lookup-v2 and child review v2 explicitly require these seams; the user approved the plan and locked guide.
seams: ReadTool application request captured by FakeSupportToolGateway
Workspace-scoped FastAPI route composed from knora.adapters.http

tdd_slices.behavior: The authorized resource and lookup request preserve exact current binding identity/version/digest through fake and SQLite gateway seams.
tdd_slices.first_red_test: The successful ReadTool request asserts the three binding values on both typed objects and SQLite defense-in-depth rejects mismatched provenance.

tdd_slices.behavior: Malformed provider result shapes and unexpected provider exceptions return ProviderContractInvalid while genuine SQLite availability failures remain ProviderUnavailable.
tdd_slices.first_red_test: Wrong-arity, non-iterable, unexpected-exception and sqlite3.OperationalError provider doubles exercise the public gateway outcome.

tdd_slices.behavior: The ticket-lookup FastAPI router belongs to knora.adapters.http and knora.tools remains application-only.
tdd_slices.first_red_test: An adapter ownership test imports knora.adapters.http.tools and proves knora.tools.http no longer exists while existing HTTP behavior remains green.
